tagline.en_US: A web-based toolkit for working with PDF files on your own server.

description.en_US: Stirling PDF is an open-source PDF manipulation platform with a web-based interface. It provides over 50 tools to edit, merge, split, sign, redact, convert, compress, and run OCR on PDF files. The application also supports no-code automation pipelines and REST APIs, allowing all operations to be processed locally without sending documents to external services.
